719-5913-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-5913-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

574-1981-2415-5332.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Carmen and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1981-2415-5332.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

141-5100-5256.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5100-5256.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing a player to mill card(s).
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2281-3175-4247.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sun Titan
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

222-527-1251-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1251-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-1251-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2111-3545-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4284-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4284-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4284-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

1003-2459-5860-6516.easyPrerequisites:

Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

Put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3259-4742-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4742-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2112-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2112-2511-6972.notes: If Hound of Griselbrand starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

4659-5365-7363.description:
Activate a Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis's third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Repeat.
4659-5365-7363.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities

240-803-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Arcane Adaptation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-803-2511.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

489-4013-4659-5004-6643.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.

Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck size is less than or equal to 2 plus your devotion to blue.
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}. When it enters, it triggers, causing you to win the game.

2292-3678-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1209-4766-5231-7091.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Kozilek, adding {R}.
When Kozilek dies, it, Heirloom Blade and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Kozilek trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Heirloom Blade trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature that shares a card type with Kozilek and put it into your hand
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Activate Heirloom Blade's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.
1209-4766-5231-7091.notes: The returned creature may be Kozilek or not. If it isn't, simply ignore the trigger shuffling it into your library, and replace all instances of Kozilek with the returned creature for that iteration.

Activate Volrath by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

546-2544-4331-6788.description:
Activate Ramos by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast to gain sunburst.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Solar Array.
Activate Drafna by paying {1}{U}, returning Ramos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Ramos by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Solar Array triggers, giving Ramos sunburst, which will cause it to enter the battlefield with five +1/+1 counters.
Repeat.

Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft triggers, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

215-2246-4893-6726.description:
Cast Ruby either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} due to Bard Class plus commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Ruby by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {G}, returning Ruby from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-2246-4893-6726.notes: If Bard Class is level 3, you will also exile your library with the ability to play the exiled cards until end of turn.

2511-4484-4871-5643-6709.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
2511-4484-4871-5643-6709.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2511-4484-4871-5643-6709.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1491-2760-5231-6667.description:
Acitvate Loporrit Scout by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Loporrit Scout triggers, giving Loporrit Scout +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Loporrit Scout ability from step 1, untapping it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the ability from step 1, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

413-1636-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
413-1636-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

730-2034-2366-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

313-640-1742-1745-3503.description:
Cast Spectral Arcanist by paying {3}{U}.
When Spectral Arcanist enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Corpse Dance, adding {B}.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's first ability by paying {B} and sacrificing Spectral Arcanist.
When Spectal Arcanist dies, Dross Harvester's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Lord of the Forsaken ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability twice by paying 2 life, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast a spell from your graveyard.
Resolve the Spectral Arcanist trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {2} to cast Corpse Dance from your graveyard with buyback.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Spectral Arcanist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

678-914-5147.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
678-914-5147.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Dockside Extortionist to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
If opponents control three or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1445-1651-1913.notablePrerequisites:
You control an artifact that can tap to produce at least {B}.
You have at least one artifact creature card in hand.
You have at least one artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1651-1913.description:
Activate a mana-producing artifact you control by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding an artifact creature card, returning another artifact creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Necron Warriors, untapping the mana-producing artifact.
Repeat.

687-2220-2301-4050.description:
Cast Deadly Grub by paying {2}{B}.
Deadly Grub enters the battlefield with three time counters and a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing the three time counters from Deadly Grub.
Deadly Grub's vanishing ability triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Deadly Grub, adding {1}.
Deadly Grub dies, triggering itself and Abzan Ascendancy.
Resolve the Deadly Grub trigger, creating a 6/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Insect and Spirit tokens, adding {2}.
Resolve the Deadly Grub trigger from step 4, doing nothing since Deadly Grub is no longer on the battlefield.
Resolve the Tayam ability from step 3, causing you to mill three cards and return Deadly Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
